answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 35050 Country: India Title: What is the equivalent weight of one sa'a in kilograms? Please give details. Question: What is the equivalent weight of one sa'a in kilograms? Please give details. Answer ID: 35050 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1676/1676/M=1432) According to prevalent measurement, one sa' is 3150.280 gm. (Al-Auzan al-Mahmuda) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
